claims.claim: UK published AI regulatory framework diverging from EU AI Act approach.
claims.uncertainty: Implementation depends on sector regulators who may align anyway.

claims.claim: Dual-compliance burden increases costs for cross-border firms.
claims.uncertainty: Magnitude varies by sector and firm size.

evidence.name: UK DSIT AI regulation white paper
limits: White paper, not legislation; implementation uncertain

limits: Self-reported; may overstate costs for lobbying purposes
